heard: No nation can ever on the moon. During the height of the Cold War, the United States and the Soviet Union faced a dangerous new frontier. In 1967, rivals signed this treaty across three global capitals to prevent the space race from turning nuclear. This agreement strictly bans countries from placing nuclear weapons or weapons of mass destruction in Earth orbit. It forbids nations from claiming any celestial bodies. The treaty only bans nukes, not conventional weapons. While the moon remains a zone of peace, the legality of commercial asteroid mining is still fiercely debated. Today, this legal shield ensures that no nation can ever own the moon.
